request.summary: 修订计划可进入已授权的最小 Node importer 诊断隔离修复：目标、模块边界、内部诊断保留和合法业务字段保护明确；测试针对真实边界且复用已有回归。没有需要先改写计划的阻断性发现。既有 partial product_db 缓存不会仅靠新 tail upsert 自动删除旧诊断项，计划已经保留无法安全收敛时记录缺口并再明确范围的分支；该限制仍属于 S2 未完成验收，不能据草稿通过宣称旧库/cache 修复或 S2 PASS。

conditions.text: 后续修复在 Node importer 的产品投影构造边界按已验证事件来源/schema 排除内部 Diagnostic 行及其 eventFacts；保留 Rust/AnalysisBatch、durable staging/checkpoint 的诊断。不得按合法业务字段名 diagnostic/code/sourcePath/requestId 递归过滤，不得降低 unknown/partial/canonical 安全判定。该条件已在授权计划中。

代码修改或重放已经 published 的原 batch 并不能证明产品库已更新。acceptComplete 会跳过 publishedAt 已有的产品 batch，Store 同 batch 不同 canonicalHash 会拒绝冲突。修复后通过既有单链 source-ready/normal analyze/publication 获得真实有效的新发布证据，检查新的 canonical rows/provider/DTO 和内部诊断保留；不修改旧 receipt、手工清库或另造采集链。无需为这个具体实施细节改写现已明确的正常发布计划。

同 provider=product_db 且新 range.coverageComplete=false 时，Android commitRangeStaging 不触发 replaceStaticRange，仅合并 upserts；新增不同 rangeId 也不因此删除旧静态 items。原证据是 partial/has_more_before=true 的 95 项缓存，含 45 Diagnostic。新 tail 不含 Diagnostic 与旧缓存已无 Diagnostic 是不同结论。当前计划已经要求验证旧状态收敛，并在既有语义不能安全收敛时记录缺口、再明确增补范围；可以先实施 Node 修复，但不得用全新/清空缓存或虚报 coverageComplete 验收既有缓存清理，也不得借本草稿审查扩大 delete/reorder/authority 边界。

扩展既有产品流/importer 集成测试，实际通过 importer 产品构造和 Store/provider 观察内部 Diagnostic 被隔离、内部 staging 保留以及业务同名字段保留。只在假造 product read model 上测 provider 不能证明 importer 正确；不为每种 carrier 复制整套测试，不为管理记录重跑未触及的 Rust broad suite。既有产品流及 canonical/partial/ACK、重开/幂等回归可按实际改动复用。
补齐一个真实 product item 稳定键、字段路径和值对应的 App 可见观察，并关联同次 product_db 页/ACK/cache 证据。普通终态文本、会话 PATH header、ACK 或数据库字段本身不替代可见事件事实；无需新增来源标牌或改变 healthy IPC authority。S2 原 R2/R3 保持 open，须后续真实执行和 change review 判断。

coverage.original_human_scope_decision: 先授权，你先处理授权事项，不要直接execute-step
coverage.adopted_scope: Minimal Node importer product diagnostic isolation plus unchanged S2 real event field visibility requirement. Original S1 scope/result retained; S3/S4 scope unchanged.
coverage.goal_acceptance_scope: Consistent. Scope amendment closes authorization mismatch from original R2 scope note; it does not resolve the underlying R2 product defect or R3 visibility gap.
module_boundaries: Node projection fix remains separate from closed Rust compatibility task; AD-022 preserved
No new source identity, public protocol, SQLite transaction/schema, collector singleflight, IPC follower/owner or realtime authority design change
Source paths/checkpoints/job/batch internal metadata remain internal; legitimate business values preserved

feasibility.projection: Existing productRowsFromSnapshot grouping/union is the concrete isolated correction point; publication gate and transaction remain intact
feasibility.publication: Normal valid new publication required; existing published receipt replay is not a migration
feasibility.old_cache: Same-provider partial cache merge cannot alone remove absent old diagnostics. This is a known declared limitation/branch, not a reason to forbid independent in-scope Node implementation; no unconditional S2 completion is approved.
feasibility.UI: Existing Task005 event fact visibility and device smoke are retained; new evidence still required

test_admission.protection: Known product Diagnostic contamination and over-filtering of legitimate event payload values
test_admission.detection: Would fail the current unfiltered projection; must also fail broad key-name filtering. Uses actual importer/Store/provider boundary, not a provider-only self-validating mock.
reuse: tests/codexHistoryProductFlow.test.js existing real Rust publication, Store reopen and business-field/provider checks
Existing importer durable staging/canonical/partial/ACK regressions in tests/codexRolloutCollector.test.js
Existing Task005 Android wire/cache/ViewModel validations only when affected
test_admission.over_testing: No redundant per-carrier suites, no new permanent automation solely for management receipt, no mandatory unmodified Rust full suite
test_admission.under_testing: Old-cache retention and actual visible field evidence explicitly remain validation obligations; delivery/ACK alone cannot satisfy them

historical_evidence.note: Reused fixed journal observations from the original S2 review; no live DB/cache reread or device activity this draft review
historical_evidence.old_reports_freshness: No change to Task004 four stale reports or prior subjects

not_run: Product implementation, test/build execution, service restart, ADB/device/host interaction or fresh E2E
No plan rewrite/adoption, execution recording, step finish/advance, Git, deployment, lifecycle change or management-issue repair

provenance.reviewer: current root agent; same agent authored the amended plan
provenance.method: Read exact plan, user decision/adoption, current source/contracts, existing tests, and retained actual change review; assess feasibility, safety boundaries and validation value

limits: Draft readiness is limited to the adopted minimal repair scope; it is not product PASS, change-review clean, old-cache cleanup, independent review or release verification.
Current user invoked review only; prior scope-only authorization is retained. No execute-step is invoked or implied by this review.
S2 remains in-progress/needs-revision, R2/R3 open; S3/S4 not-started.
Existing issue-ec19a134aefeb23287cb519b remains unresolved. Link/correct/resolve/defer remain separate possible management actions, with no business replay.
remaining_work: On a subsequent implementation request, execute the authorized S2 Node repair with the stated boundaries and meaningful regression.
Verify valid new product publication and report the actual old partial cache convergence limitation without inventing cleanup.
Supplement real App visible event field evidence and record a new execution for change review; no automatic finish.

recommendation.reason: Exact amended plan is already adopted and ready for the bounded repair; this is advice for a subsequent user request, not action now.
